brief: Triage every open row of .sir/backlog.md at 4d874be: 132 rows (MASTER-158 under Permanently deferred is untouched). T7 then applies the records and C2 to .sir/backlog.md and .sir/lessons.md, keeping both CRLF with no lone CR: rows removed, rewritten as work with a check, or routed to lessons.md as tagged standing rules. Human and Appium checks are rewritten as numbered steps with a pass condition and a commit anchor. No src, test or docs change.
